licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages by two independent readers, with a judge settling every difference and a sweep for the marks, then a fresh check until clean, and checked against the print again here; every bar of every part adds up. The Italian translation and the stage directions are left out. Playback tempo from the median length of complete recordings (Klemperer 1964 1:09, Böhm 1964 0:54, Abbado 2005 1:00, Christie 1995 1:09).
